description: Voice samples: add under consent, delete, read audio.
precondition: User with consent; speech worker replaced.

preconditions: User owns a sample whose recording was kept.
cases.inputs: actorId: the sample owner; sampleId: a sample with kept audio.
cases.return: The decrypted bytes with their content type.

preconditions: The sample belongs to another person.
cases.inputs: actorId: a user; sampleId: another person sample.
cases.return: Null; someone else sample is answered exactly like one that does not exist.

preconditions: User owns a sample recorded under notice "1.0", which kept no recording.
cases.inputs: actorId: the sample owner; sampleId: a sample without kept audio.
cases.return: Null; only samples under a consent that says so keep their recording.

preconditions: User owns a sample whose audio no longer decrypts after a key change.
cases.inputs: actorId: the sample owner; sampleId: a sample with an unreadable recording.
cases.return: Null; the person is simply not heard back.
cases.log: Warning logged with the sample id.
